title_as_printed: Table 3: The dissolution of NaCl in water at 59.2 C; nw = moles of water, n1 = moles of pure solid sodium chloride
pressure_note: not stated (calorimetric dissolution in water; no pressure printed)

value.what: molar dissolution enthalpy of solid NaCl to final molality m, = dH_exp / n_1 (authors' division of the measured heat)

value2.what: measured heat of dissolution of n_1 mol NaCl in n_w mol water (raw calorimeter result, sign as printed: positive)

composition.other_species: water; molality is that of the final solution after dissolving n_1 mol NaCl in n_w mol water (m = n_1/(n_w x 0.018015) numerically consistent); per kg water implied by n_w

conversion_needs: n_w and n_1 are amounts per experiment, not per kg
notes: Isothermal batch calorimetry (SETARAM C80D); T printed to 0.1 C in caption (24.4, 44.3, 59.2 C).
